definition: I. רָאמוֺת noun [feminine plural] usually corals (so Ki ; black corals Thes ( פְּנִינִים = red corals ); compare Arabic , sea-shell , We Heid. 2. 163 ); — as costly Job 28:18 , as merchandise, רָאמֹת Ezek 27:16 — רָאמוֺת לֶאֱוִיל חָכְמוֺת Prov 24:7 , reading and sense dubious, see Toy. רָֽאֲמָה , II. רָאמוֺת , רָאמַת see רום , II. רמה . above
